title: Choose the radar look
question: Function stays: rear and side blips, you near the top, closer riders run larger and more orange, no blind-spot wedges. Pick the composition to build, combine, revise, or reject.

options.label: Range Arcs
options.thesis: Distance becomes a graphic: faint arcs centered on the bike, so close vs far is a glance, not a guess.
options.viewport: Square night-ink plaque on black. White bike in the upper third. Three hairline arcs centered on the bike, more behind than ahead. Heat-colored circular blips. Tiny dim 6 / 12 on the outer arcs.
options.risk: Arc labels can clutter at HUD scale if they compete with the blips.

options.label: Disc Field
options.thesis: The square plaque stays; the plot becomes a circle, so the corners stop stealing attention from traffic.
options.viewport: Square 6px plaque. Circular field inset with one outer hairline ring. Bike at the top of the disc, not the center. Faint vertical centerline. Same heat blips in the lower two-thirds.
options.risk: A circle can read as generic game radar if the ring gets glow or a sweep.

options.label: Broadcast Plaque
options.thesis: Radar joins Dash and Standings: a named TV plaque whose body happens to be a spatial plot.
options.viewport: Square plaque with a darker header: RADAR in dim ExtraBold Italic, left inset. Body is the same bike-plus-blips plot with a faint vertical centerline. No rings.
options.risk: A title on a glance widget can waste the pixels that should be traffic.
